description: Bug 1 + Bug 3: Add className='w-full' to every TextField missing it (17 files), and remove nested max-h-*/overflow-y-auto wrappers inside DialogContent (2 files). Both are purely mechanical edits with no logic changes. Independent from FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Read context.json at /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata/apps/web/.agents/tasks/task-mui-v2-regression/context.json and this FEAT file before touching any source.

components/import/csv-import-dialog.tsx L519: change <div data-mapping-scroll className='px-6 space-y-4 max-h-[55vh] overflow-y-auto'> to <div data-mapping-scroll className='px-6 space-y-4'>. Remove max-h-[55vh] and overflow-y-auto only.

Run tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json from workspace root. Fix any type errors introduced. Then run pnpm --filter @strata/web build.
Update this FEAT's status to 'completed' in FEAT-001.json and record any findings. Commit locally on the current branch with message 'fix(ui): add TextField w-full + fix dialog scroll (FEAT-001)'.
